name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-interactive-3d-scene
title: Interactive 3D Scene
shortDescription: Builds a self-contained, clickable 3D scene for the SharePoint HTML viewer using the host's Babylon.js library, with a 2D fallback, optional sound and a demo mode.
longDescription: Turns a theme or occasion, such as a team celebration, a seasonal greeting or a product launch, into a playful 3D scene with 3 to 6 tappable objects that glow, bounce, shake, spin, flash or burst into sparks.

Outputs a single HTML file that follows the SharePoint HTML viewer rules: no external files, the Babylon.js library requested through the host manifest, and a finished SVG drawing with the same reactions when 3D is not available.

Includes keyboard and button access, a live status line, reduced motion support, sound synthesized with Web Audio that stays off until the viewer turns it on, and a demo mode for 16:9 or 9:16 screen recordings. Ships with a starter template and reference guides so the pattern can be reused for any theme.
